name: Category_Five
display_fullname: Mission Maker Attacks Storm Blast Category Five
display_help:
Summons a severe storm that begins light, but grows in power until it becomes a raging engine of destruction. Left on its own, the Category Five storm is capable of delivering moderate damage and will increase your storm strength over time. As it grows in power, foes may begin to fling through the air.

In addition, each use of your Storm Blast powers is capable of delivering lightning attacks within the Category Five storm, delivering energy damage.
